Summary: Snowflake to SFMC Automated Audience Import
User Story: As a Campaign Specialist, I want automated nightly imports from Snowflake to SFMC Data Extensions, so that my audiences are always fresh without manual CSV uploads.
Acceptance Criteria (Gherkin): Given a new delta file is dropped in SFTP by 02:00 AM, When Automation Studio runs the import activity, Then data is populated into 'DE_Member_Master' with 0 duplicate SubscriberKeys.

Summary: Fall-back Trigger to SMS on Email Inaction
User Story: As a Marketing Manager, I want Journey Builder to trigger an SMS if an email is unread after 48 hours, so that we maximize appointment compliance.
Acceptance Criteria (Gherkin): Given a member is sent an Email, When 'Email Open' event is false after 48 hours AND SMS_OptIn is True, Then route member to MobileConnect SMS activity.

Summary: AcuCall IVR Auto-Dial Trigger for Unconfirmed Bookings
User Story: As a Care Coordinator, I want critical care reminders escalated to automated IVR calls, so that high-risk members do not miss preventive screenings.
Acceptance Criteria (Gherkin): Given a member has an open care gap > 15 days, When reached in journey step 4, Then make an outbound API payload call to AcuCall IVR with Member_ID and Callback_Slot.

Summary: TCPA Quiet Hours and Consent Suppression
User Story: As a Compliance Officer, I want dynamic blocking of voice/SMS outside local legal hours, so that the organization avoids TCPA violations.
Acceptance Criteria (Gherkin): Given a member's local time zone is EST, When a trigger occurs before 08:00 AM or after 21:00 EST, Then suppress the dispatch until 09:00 AM local time.

Summary: NICE CXone Queue Integration for Campaign Callbacks
User Story: As a Contact Center Agent, I want warm campaign leads routed directly to my CXone desktop, so that I can assist members who request live callbacks.
Acceptance Criteria (Gherkin): Given a member texts 'AGENT' in response to an SMS, When the webhook hits NICE CXone API, Then create an inbound skill-based task for available agents within 30 seconds.
